contentText: Israel's new parliament was sworn in Tuesday with opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot aiming to build a coalition after receiving a mandate to form a government. Eisenkot's party moved to immediately set up a commission to investigate failures that allowed Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack, a move long resisted by caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Follow our live coverage for the latest updates.
